relocation_line: I will relocate to Adelaide for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi Fyfe team,

My name's Marc. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). Your Graduate Civil Engineer role in Adelaide includes stormwater drainage design, which I worked on in the course, so I'm sending my application.

During the diploma I prepared drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, and put together cost estimates and bills of quantities. Before that, from April 2019 to February 2020, I was project-in-charge and then field engineer on two building sites in the Philippines, doing site inspections and quality checks.

Moving to Adelaide is no problem, and I can start two weeks after an offer. I also have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Feel free to give me a call.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
